paragraphs.source_en: As soon as Sorori Sh左卫门 left Shōan's country residence, he passed through Rokuken-suji in Ōmachi and the ironmongers' quarter in Sakuramachi, then went straight to the boat landing at Yamato Bridge. Here he could learn something of the state of affairs in Sakai. He found no sign of anyone trying to buy weapons in secret, for there was simply no stock to be had. Every shop that forged guns and cannon was ceaselessly busy, taking orders from new customers.
